messages.text: Our top floor-standing pick is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe. It's a large, hand-assembled heirloom piece with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand — a real centrepiece for a room, and shipping is free on it. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.
